description: Re-verify a governance certificate against the API it attests to. If the API drifted or the certificate was forged, verification fails.

api.description: The API description being attested or verified. String or parsed object.

certificate.description: The governance certificate to re-verify. Alias: `cert`.

context.description: Optional: one sentence on the task you are doing. Never used to answer or rank; read only if a result is reported wrong.

name: verify_certificate
